title: Hydrocarbon vessel loss of containment
goal: Show preventative and mitigative barriers around a pressurised-hydrocarbon vessel release.

rubric.must: A pressurised-hydrocarbon hazard header and a central loss-of-containment top event are visible.
Multiple labelled threats visibly pass through preventative barriers before reaching the top event.
Multiple labelled consequences visibly sit beyond mitigative barriers from the top event.
The ultrasonic inspection barrier visibly has an escalation factor and a risk-based-inspection barrier beneath it.
Corrosion, overpressure, vehicle impact, and gasket degradation appear as separate threat paths.
Jet fire, vapour cloud explosion, and personnel exposure appear as separate consequence paths.
The picture has a clear left-threat, central-event, right-consequence bowtie structure.

ideal.notes: Updated 2026-09-14 against exemplar visual-eval/exemplars/bowtie/ideal.svg (sha256 4484bd18b387). Exemplar role palette: orange threats, grey barriers, green top event, red consequences and yellow escalation factors. Existing scenario topology retained. Visually inspected at full size and across the case family; independent targets, not engine-output snapshots.
